text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > /tmp/exposed-wheel-restore/design-verdict.md <<'EOF'
# Verdict

Use Astra as the base sketch: add required `rimPath` beside the existing closed `path`, preserving caller ownership of geometry. It most directly fulfills the restoration while keeping the current public contract and rendering model recognizable. Its refinement already incorporates inner radius 40, group/person/flag/building, a centered decorative chart icon, and the existing 220px footprint.

Sol correctly identifies duplicated outer-arc geometry as the main weakness. Its quadrant enum would centralize geometry and shrink callers, but also narrows a presently caller-defined shape contract and changes geometry ownership solely for this restyle. That is a larger abstraction migration than this task requires. Required explicit `rimPath` is an honest extension of the current API; document that it is the open outer boundary in the same local coordinates as `path`. Do not extract it by splitting/parsing SVG strings. Keep the pair together in each caller/fixture.

Luna is a useful secondary source for neutral focus and clipped native buttons, but needs corrections: MPs must use group, the centered icon is required rather than conditional, and the permanent accent surface must not become selected-dependent. Do not render an actual data chart for a decorative center glyph.

## Binding implementation details

- Retain closed `path` for surface and native button clip hit area. Add a separate required open `rimPath` for the outer arc only. Keep focus as a neutral full-sector outline with explicit selectors/layering so the selected rim does not obscure keyboard focus.
- Selection changes only outer-rim emphasis. Every unselected rim remains muted; sector fill, fine closed boundary, labels, and icons retain exactly the same muted/accent presentation across selection states. Do not use the existing selected closed-path stroke/fill behavior.
- Keep the page footprint 220px and current 284-unit scaled canvas. Change inner radius to 40 in all relevant closed paths and fixtures while leaving outer130 arcs intact.
- Set MPs/group top-left; Individuals/person top-right; Parties/flag bottom-left; Companies/building bottom-right. Swap complete geometry assignments for the lower categories, preserving IDs and ranking semantics.
- Add a centered, muted neutral, aria-hidden bar-chart icon with no pointer events. Scope main SVG dimensions to a dedicated class so nested icon SVGs retain their own size.
- Prefer Astra's icon32/label17 source dimensions as the first screenshot candidate at 220px, then judge label fit visually.

Verify interaction and visible focus using existing feature/gallery coverage, then inspect the actual 220px rendered wheel. Selection screenshots must show only the outer rim changing. No financial logic or copy changes are warranted.
EOF","max_output_tokens":1000}));
